notes: One-word asks now reach the right lane. "loop it" worked and "loop" did not; "stabilize it" worked and "steady" did not — the shortest way to say a thing was the one Crisp claimed not to understand. "loop", "repeat", "steady", "stable" and "make it steady" all plan now, while "the loop is wrong" and "a steady shot" are still left alone, because they describe rather than ask. And "turn it" no longer pretends not to understand: turn reaches three different jobs — "rotate it 90 degrees" turns the picture, "turn it up" is the volume, "make it vertical" changes the shape — so Crisp names all three instead of guessing one.
